note: Class: rival account of what 'God' does in worship (WF-P1, early Phillips, reported by SEP-RELIGIOUS-LANGUAGE §4.1). It denies that the name applies to any being, so it is a rival to every nominal identification of God on the root routes. Not refuted: the sourced defeat WF-FAILS-AS-DESCRIPTION-OF-CATHOLIC-PRACTICE targets the cut-off thesis, and the parallel argument from Dei Filius ch. 1 and can. I.1-3 (God a substance really distinct from the world, the denial condemned) is not built (blocker: a typed reference relation). Phillips's later view (STMT-PHILLIPS-REALISM-CONCEPTS-RELIGION-INTERNAL) withdraws the denial of reference. No refutes relation.
